newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - ZAG Industries a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - ZAG Industries a buy.

text.p: -- Robertson, Stephens & Co said its analyst Ed Weller started coverage of ZAG Industries with a buy rating based on a diversified product line and rapid growth expectations.

-- ZAG, based in Israel, makes and sells consumer products made primarily of molded plastic. It has a line of about 60 products and expects to roll out another 30 new products in the next year, according to a written statement by Weller.
-- He estimates the company will earn $1.03 a share in 1997 and $1.33 a share in 1998.
-- ZAG shares were up 4/16 at 16-9/16 by mid-morning on Wednesday.
